face.definition: A face is the front part of the head.
face.sentence: His face was red with embarrassment.

facility.definition: A place's facilities are its rooms, equipment, and services.
facility.sentence: The town now has the cleanest wastewater treatment facility in the state.

fact.definition: A fact is a piece of information that is true.
fact.sentence: That is not just my idea, it is a fact.

factor.definition: A factor is one of a number of things that causes a result.
factor.sentence: The main factor in the success of our program is our excellent teachers.

factory.definition: A factory is a building where lots of things are made.
factory.sentence: This factory makes one hundred cars every day.

fade.definition: When something fades, it slowly disappears.

fail.definition: To not achieve a goal, or to go wrong.
fail.sentence: The event is going to fail.

failure.definition: A failure is someone or something that fails, or does not achieve a goal.
failure.sentence: I was a failure at my first job.

fair.definition: Something is fair when it seems right or is done for a good purpose.
fair.sentence: A law is fair when good people are not hurt by it.

fairly.definition: Fairly is when something is between slightly and very.
fairly.sentence: The sun was shining brightly today, however the light breeze still made it feel fairly chilly.

faith.definition: Faith is the belief that something is true without proof.

faithfully.definition: If a person does something faithfully, he or she does it in a faithful or loyal manner.
faithfully.sentence: I have been faithfully married for the past twenty years.

fall.definition: When something or someone falls, it moves down quickly down through the air because nothing is holding it. It moves to a lower position because of gravity.

false.definition: If something is false, it is not true or not real.
false.sentence: My grandfather takes out his false teeth at night.

familiar.definition: If something is familiar, you already know it or about it.
familiar.sentence: Why would someone leave familiar territory and travel all this distance.

family.definition: A family is a group of people with a blood or marriage relation.
family.sentence: My parents and my two brothers are my family.

famous.definition: If someone or something is famous, then many people know about them.
famous.sentence: Judy Garland was a famous singer.

fan.definition: A fan is a thing that moves air to help people stay cool; either a small paper thing a person holds in their hand, or a machine with a part that turns fast to push the air.
fan.sentence: She held the fan in front of her face so people wouldn't see her smile.

fancy.definition: If something is fancy, it nicer than usual, often with decorations and bright colours.
fancy.sentence: That's a very fancy dress you're wearing.

fantastic.definition: Existing in or constructed from fantasy; of or relating to fantasy; fanciful.
fantastic.sentence: He told fantastic stories of dragons and goblins.

far.sentence: I saw her at the far side of the room.

farm.definition: A piece of land where people work growing plants and animals. Usually, a farm makes food for its owners to eat or sell.
farm.sentence: We grow cows and apples on our farm.

farmer.definition: Someone whose job is to raise animals or plants, often for food.

fascinate.definition: Fascinate means a person or thing that interests someone very much.

fashion.definition: A fashion is a style, often clothing, that is popular at a particular time and place.
fashion.sentence: The fashion was for men to have long hair.

fast.definition: When you are fast, you can move a in very short time.

fat.definition: If a person or animal is fat, it is big and heavy because it has too much fat.
fat.sentence: I got really fat when I was in university because I ate every meal at McDonalds.

father.definition: The father of a person is the man who is one of that person's parents.
father.sentence: The father of Bill Smith IV is Bill Smith III.

fault.definition: If something is your fault, you did something wrong or didn't do something right.
fault.sentence: It doesn't matter whose fault it is, let's work together to make it right.

favor.sentence: Can you please do me a favor by washing the dishes?

favorite.definition: My favorite brand is the brand I like most.
favorite.sentence: Ford is my favorite brand of truck.

fear.definition: To have a fear of someone or something means to be scared of someone or something; to be afraid of someone or something.
fear.sentence: He was struck with fear when he thought he saw a ghost.

feature.definition: A feature is a special or noticeable part of something.
feature.sentence: One unusual feature of the town is the river in the middle of mainstreet.

federal.definition: The federal government is the main country-wide government in a country where there are also state or provincial governments.
federal.sentence: The federal government has said that it will not increase payments to the provinces.

fee.definition: A fee is the money you pay for some kinds of services, such as legal advice, education, or club membership.
fee.sentence: He held his lands in fee of the Earl of Chester.

feed.definition: When you feed someone, you give them food to eat.
feed.sentence: I feed my dog chicken bones every day.

feel.definition: If you feel that something is the case, you have a strong idea in your mind that it is the case.
feel.sentence: I feel that not enough is being done to protect the local animal life.

fellow.definition: A fellow is a friend; a partner; a companion.
fellow.sentence: I have been traveling with my fellow adventurers.

female.definition: If something is female, it is of, for, or about women or girls.
female.sentence: The girls can change in the female changing room over there.

fence.definition: A fence is a person who buys things from people who stole the things, and then sells the things again to other people.
fence.sentence: I don't think anyone will steal this, because they wouldn't get much money for it. They'd have to sell it to a fence.

festival.definition: A festival is an organized event that contains a number of performances and usually happens every year.
festival.sentence: Many actors are in town for the Toronto international film festival.

few.sentence: It was designed for the discriminating few.

fiction.definition: Fiction refers to things that were made up and are not true.
fiction.sentence: The events in that story did not happen so it is fiction.

field.definition: A field is an open area of land that can be used for many different things, from sports to crop-growing.
field.sentence: He was an expert in the field of American history.

fight.definition: When two people fight against each other, they hit each other and try to hurt each other.
fight.sentence: When that husband and wife fight with each other, they don't hit. They just yell at each other.

figure.definition: Figures are numbers showing the value or amount of something.
figure.sentence: The figure of Margaret Thatcher towers over the Falklands War.

file.definition: A file is a set of papers or records on a specific issue, person, etc.
file.sentence: The letter should be in the file on the Herzog problem.

fill.definition: If you fill something, you put something in it until there is no space left.
fill.sentence: She added some games to fill the gap in the schedule.

film.definition: A film is a recording of a moving picture that tells stories including actors, directors, and producers.
film.sentence: The studio has hired some actors to make a film about the making of Wiktionary.

filter.definition: A filter is a piece of equipment that put gas or liquid through to take out the parts you don't want, to clean it.
filter.sentence: Car engines have a fuel filter to keep the fuel clean.

final.definition: The final thing is the last one.
final.sentence: Today is the final day to register for university.

finally.definition: If something finally happens, it means there was a long wait before it happened.
finally.sentence: I finally finished university. Now, I can start my real life.

finance.definition: Finance is activities related to banking and money, especially by government.

financial.definition: A financial problem, issue, activity or other thing is about money or business.
financial.sentence: Our sales are down and we have serious financial problems.

find.definition: If you find something, you discover or locate it.
find.sentence: I can't find my keys. Have you seen them?

fine.definition: If something is fine, it is OK, not a problem, or acceptable.
fine.sentence: She said it works -- it's fine.

finger.definition: A finger is a long thin part of your hand that bends. Most people have four fingers and one thumb on each hand.
finger.sentence: He only uses one finger on the keyboard.

finish.definition: If something finishes, it stops and doesn't start again; it comes to the end.
finish.sentence: Finish up your lunch quickly, please.

fire.definition: A chemical reaction that makes heat and flames or smoldering.
fire.sentence: We sat around the fire singing songs and telling stories.

firm.definition: A firm is a group of people who work together as a business.
firm.sentence: John & John is a law firm.

firmly.definition: If you do something firmly, you do it in a firm or strong way.

first.definition: Happening or coming before all other similar things or people.
first.sentence: I don't like the job much at first.

firstly.definition: If you are somewhere firstly, you are the earliest.
firstly.sentence: The gardener arrived at the office firstly.

fish.definition: A fish is an animal that lives in the water and has scales and gills.
fish.sentence: When I went fishing, I only caught two fish.

fit.definition: When you fit something, you match a thing for size, shape or other qualities.
fit.sentence: These shoes fit me very well.

fix.definition: When a person fixes something, they repair it.
fix.sentence: A piece of chewing gum will fix your note to the bulletin board.

flag.definition: A flag is a piece of cloth, usually marked with a colourful symbol or sign.
flag.sentence: Be ready to start running immediately at the flag.

flash.definition: A flash is a sudden bright light.
flash.sentence: He used the flash on his camera.

flat.definition: If something is flat, it has a surface with no high places or low places.
flat.sentence: There are a lot of mountains, and very little flat land for farming.

flexible.definition: When something is flexible, it can bend.
flexible.sentence: The thin wood stick was so flexible that it would bend but not break.

flight.definition: Flight is the act of flying: moving through the air using wings.
flight.sentence: Birds have had flight for millions of years.

float.definition: Something which stays on or near the surface of water or another liquid.
float.sentence: Attach the float and the weight to the fishing line, above the hook.

flood.definition: A flood happens when there has been a lot of rain in a short time and the water covers the ground.

floor.definition: The floor is the flat part at the bottom of a room. People stand on the floor.
floor.sentence: Don't drop your milk on the floor.

flow.definition: If something flows, it moves in a smooth and regular way.

flower.definition: A flower is part of a plant. Flowers are often very pretty. Plants make them so that they can make new seeds.
flower.sentence: The flower of the plant is starting to wilt.

fly.definition: To move through the air without touching the ground.
fly.sentence: The bird will fly away in the winter.

focus.definition: If you focus on something, you pay special attention to it.
focus.sentence: A small company will probably focus its attention on each artist's project more than a major label.

fold.definition: If you fold something thin such as paper, you bend it so it touches itself.
fold.sentence: Fold the egg whites into the batter.

folk.sentence: Often, doctors have difficulty explaining things to ordinary folk like me.

follow.definition: If the first thing occurs after the second, thing the first thing follows a second thing.
follow.sentence: A dog that is trained well should always follow its owner.

food.definition: Food is what people and animals eat for nutrition or pleasure when they are hungry.

fool.definition: A fool is a person who does or thinks stupid things.

foot.definition: The lowest part of the leg, below the ankle; the part of the body used to stand on.
foot.sentence: He hurt his foot playing football.

football.definition: A football is the ball used in a football game.

force.definition: A force is the act of a thing pushing on another thing, or how strongly it pushes.
force.sentence: The force of the hammer hitting the nail pushes the nail into the wood.

forecast.definition: To forecast is to make an educated guess about the future.

foreign.definition: Foreign means something that comes from a different place or country. Foreign people are known as foreigners.

forest.definition: A forest is an area covered with many trees, and sometimes by bushes and other plants.

forget.definition: When you forget something, you have no memory of it.
forget.sentence: I forget every thing that you tell me.

form.definition: Form is the shape or structure of a person or a thing.
form.sentence: To join with the club, please fill in this application form.

formal.definition: If something is formal, it is official and/or public.
formal.sentence: He studied German on his own, but he has no formal language education.

format.definition: The format of some writing is the way it is organized: the size and colour of the letters, the way it is divided into parts, the kind of words used.
format.sentence: What format do you want the report written in?

former.definition: A former x (e.g., president, country, wife) used to be the x but is not anymore.
former.sentence: Former president Clinton was giving a speech at the school.

formula.definition: A formula is a way to do something or solve a problem that does not change much.
formula.sentence: There is no formula for making profit, yet many business people think there is.

forth.definition: From a particular thing or place or position (‘forth’ is obsolete)

fortunate.definition: If you are fortunate good things have happened to you, or you have good things.
fortunate.sentence: You are very fortunate to have such good friends.

fortune.definition: A fortune is a very large amount of money.
fortune.sentence: A million dollars is a fortune.

forward.definition: If someone is forward, they are too friendly when talking to strangers.
forward.sentence: The forward section of the aircraft.

found.definition: The past tense and past participle of find.

foundation.definition: The foundation of something is the basic ideas or work behind it.
foundation.sentence: Her education gave her a solid foundation in all the major subjects.

fragment.definition: A portion or part of something.

frame.definition: The parts of a building that are strong and that hold the other parts up.
frame.sentence: Now that the frame is done, we can start on the walls.

framework.definition: A framework is basic ideas and organisation that you can build an argument, a book, a society, etc. around.
framework.sentence: The aim of the course is to provide a comprehensive framework for practical and theoretical study in Art and Design.

free.definition: If something is free, it does not cost money to buy.
free.sentence: The government provides free healthcare for people who cannot afford it.

freedom.definition: The state of being free; the state of not being imprisoned or enslaved.
freedom.sentence: He enjoyed his freedom after he was released from prison.

freeze.definition: If you freeze something, you cool it until it becomes solid.
freeze.sentence: The chicken will go bad soon. We should freeze it and then we can cook it next week.

frequency.definition: Something's frequency is how often it happens.
frequency.sentence: A frequency of one hertz is an event repeated once per second.

frequent.definition: An event is frequent if it happens many times in a short time.
frequent.sentence: Broken toys is the most frequent reason children ask for help here.

frequently.definition: If you do something frequently, you do it often.
frequently.sentence: The library is frequently used by students.

fresh.definition: If something is fresh it is not old, it is new or like new. Often this means not spoiled or rotten.

friend.definition: Two people are friends of each other if they like being together and they like helping each other, but are not related.
friend.sentence: She's been a friend of mine for many years.

friendly.definition: If someone is friendly they are willing to become a friend, or they act like they are a friend.

friendship.definition: Friendship is being friends with someone.

frighten.definition: Frighten means a person or thing that makes someone feel afraid; to cause someone to have a fear.

front.sentence: He put up a bold front.

fruit.definition: The fruit is the part of a plant or tree that holds the seeds. It's usually sweet and good to eat.
fruit.sentence: Most people don't eat enough fruit and vegetables.

fuel.sentence: More fuel is needed during the winter months.

fulfill.definition: If you fulfill something, you meet expectations.

full.definition: A container is full of things if there are many of the things in the container and no more can go in.
full.sentence: The cup is full of water. If you try to put more water in, the water will fall onto the table.

fully.definition: If you fully understand or do something, you understand or do all of it.
fully.sentence: I have not yet been able to understand this idea fully.

fun.definition: If you have fun, you enjoy something.
fun.sentence: Thanks! I had a lot of fun today. Let's do it again.

function.definition: Something or someone's function is its purpose or its job.
function.sentence: The army sometimes performs a policing function.

functional.definition: If something is functional, it is working properly or normally.
functional.sentence: The flashlight was still functional after I dropped it down the stairs.

fund.definition: A fund is an amount of money kept for a specific purpose.
fund.sentence: GM cannot afford to keep paying into the company pension fund.

fundamental.definition: If something is fundamental, it is basic and important.
fundamental.sentence: The loss of her legs has caused her to undergo a fundamental change in how she looks at life.

funny.definition: Funny things keep people interested and can make people laugh.

furniture.definition: Furniture are items used to decorate a room or make it more comfortable.
furniture.sentence: They had too much furniture for the small apartment.

further.definition: The comparative form of far; more far.
further.sentence: Some further problems have come up.

furthermore.definition: You use furthermore to add more information to what was already said or written.
furthermore.sentence: We believe that the project is possible. Furthermore, we believe that we can do it within a few months.

future.definition: The future is the time of something that hasn't happen yet. The study of the future is known as futurology.
future.sentence: I will be more careful in the future.
